summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in diezyclutch-baileys@8.6.95
details: No static or traced findings were produced for this package version. The package name resembles a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library, but no code paths exhibiting installer-side credential theft, install-time remote code execution, silent relay of caller data to an author-controlled destination, backdoor, or self-propagation were identified in the shipped files.
